hypothesis: Using Flagsmith multivariate flag quickstart_experience (control: copy_checklist vs variant: interactive_sandbox, 50/50), a pre-filled live interactive webhook sandbox increases first_api_call_succeeded by at least +15% relative lift, while sdk_snippet_exported (guardrail) is watched to make sure developers still take the SDK into their own repo.

traffic.method: real HTTP requests, one cookie jar per visitor
traffic.disclosure: Simulated developer traffic driven by documented behavioral personas (see scripts/simulate-ab.mjs). This is not production traffic and the README says so. Variant assignment is real: it comes from Flagsmith.

senior.label: Senior / Hurried Dev
senior.description: Knows the docs already; wants the snippet and out.

explorer.label: Explorer / Evaluator
explorer.description: Wants to see the API work before reading further.

impatient.label: Impatient / Bouncer
impatient.description: Bails at the first sign of friction.

verdict.summary: Primary metric clears the bar but the guardrail regresses. Do not roll the sandbox out at 100%.
verdict.detail: The sandbox raises first_api_call_succeeded with an interval strictly above zero, while sdk_snippet_exported falls with an interval strictly below zero: some developers finish playing in the browser and leave without exporting the code. Ship a v2 that auto-surfaces the export card after the first successful call, then re-test with the guardrail as the primary metric.
